name: Bandar Malaysia
status_detail: Upcoming · Finance Ministry says redevelopment begins end-2026
summary: The redevelopment of a 486-acre former airbase at Sungai Besi into an integrated smart, transit-oriented city. Master developer is IWH-CREC Sdn Bhd (IWH 60%). The master plan (SOM) targets tourism, trade, culture and innovation uses around a proposed major rail interchange.
why_it_matters: KL's largest single-piece city development, a decade of delays and resets. The draft KL Local Plan 2040 leans on it: the proposed southward CBD expansion centres on Bandar Malaysia.
questions_to_follow: Does construction actually begin at end-2026 as stated?
Which rail links (MRT3 is planned nearby) anchor the interchange?
Do the earlier 1MDB-era obligations and ownership disputes stay resolved?
location_precision: Area-level marker on the former airbase site. Precise phase boundaries not yet published.
